notes.title: Trial version wishlist event prize draw and trial version removal announcement!
notes.notes:
After the trial version was launched, we received a lot of feedback from players. Therefore, we made drastic optimizations to the game based on the feedback from players, and even made major changes to the gameplay. Therefore, the trial version can no longer represent the gameplay to show players, so we have suspended the trial version.

Thank you for your feedback, we will try our best to make a better game!

The following is the list of user nicknames for the wish list event. We will email you one by one to inform you of the winning notification. Thank you for participating in the event!

Welcome to wait for the next game event!
